description: The graph file over the wire (docs/design/knobly-config.md, "Wire additions"), one session over the record's example file. graphFile.subscribe answers with the file, then every graphFile.changed; a change's graphFile.changed comes before the node and route events it causes, and those before the request's response. In order: an editor edit (cause edit); graphFile.set on a stale version (file-changed) and with a typo (invalid-text, with the diagnostics); a route the graph refuses (unknown-port, the file unchanged, no graphFile.changed); a hand edit with @include (cause disk, include-unsupported; running stays); node.update while the file has errors (file-invalid); the hand fix (disk); an editor edit, then a hand save over it before it was written (disk, droppedEdits 1: the hand edit wins); removing a setting a shared snippet line makes (shared-definition at that line); playback 4 through @set $ch, which replaces both cards; a write that fails, then succeeds (cause write); an editor edit, then a hand edit the graph refuses (refusal at its line, running unchanged, droppedEdits 1); graphFile.set with graph_frequency 44100 (pendingRestart); a batch [node.update, graph.subscribe] and a batch [graph.subscribe, graphFile.subscribe]. file is the graph file the client holds at the end, graph the graph.
